北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京风大体感冷，注意保暖防风，多喝水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is windy and feels cold. Stay warm, protect from wind, and hydrate!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪有点风凉，出门记得添衣，小心着凉！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cool and windy. Remember to add layers when out, avoid catching a cold!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天凉爽，体感舒适，记得带伞以防万一。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and cool, feels pleasant. Bring an umbrella just in case.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光正好，气温 25℃ 舒适，注意防晒哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and warm at 25℃. Enjoy the sunshine, mind sun protection!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳天气暖和，气温 26℃ 舒适，轻装出行很棒！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is warm at 26℃. Comfortable for light clothing, enjoy your day!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天微凉，体感 5℃ 左右，记得穿暖和点！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and cool, feels like 5℃. Remember to dress warmly!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天微凉，体感 4℃，出门别忘了加衣哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and cool, feels like 4℃. Don't forget an extra layer outside.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天温和，体感 10℃ 宜人，心情也要美美的。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and mild, feels like 10℃. Enjoy the pleasant weather!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天有点湿冷，体感 7℃，注意保暖防潮。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy and damp-cool, feels like 7℃. Stay warm and dry.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安气温低，体感 2℃，早晚温差大，注意添衣。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cold, feels like 2℃. Mind the temperature difference, dress warmly.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆湿度高，体感 9℃ 左右，带把雨伞更安心。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is very humid, feels about 9℃. Bring an umbrella for peace of mind.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨极寒，体感 -17℃！一定要穿最厚的衣服保暖。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is extremely cold, feels like -17℃! Dress in your warmest clothes to stay safe.
哈尔滨.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -17℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴冷，体感 -9℃，出门别忘了帽子手套哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is clear and cold, feels like -9℃. Don't forget your hat and gloves outside.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天温和，体感 12℃，出门带件外套备用。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and mild, feels like 12℃. Bring a jacket just in case.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门气温 20℃，风力 5级，体感偏凉，注意防风。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is 20℃ with strong winds (level 5), feels cooler. Mind the wind!
厦门.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：东北风 5级

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛晴冷风大，体感 -3℃，记得裹严实了再出门。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is clear, cold, and windy, feels like -3℃. Bundle up before heading out!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴冷，体感 -7℃，风力不小，多穿点才暖和。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is clear and cold, feels like -7℃. It's windy, so dress extra warmly!
